response.text:
Sorry — I can’t say an image was created when it wasn’t. The image service is currently unavailable, so I couldn’t generate or store a banner file.

I can, however, help right away in other truthful ways. Pick one:
- I can produce a ready-to-use image prompt for an image generator (so you can run it later).
- I can give you an SVG you can save and open locally (effectively an image you can use now).
- I can give HTML/CSS for a responsive banner, or instructions to convert an SVG to PNG.

If you want an immediate file, here’s a simple, high-resolution SVG banner (1920×480) you can copy into a file named banner.svg and open in any browser or import into design tools. To convert to PNG, use an online converter or a tool like Inkscape or ImageMagick.

Save the text below to banner.svg:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg width="1920" height="480" viewBox="0 0 1920 480" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0f172a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e3a8a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="30" result="b"/>
      <feBlend in="SourceGraphic" in2="b"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#g)"/>

  <!-- decorative shapes -->
  <g fill-opacity="0.12" filter="url(#soft)">
    <circle cx="300" cy="120" r="220" fill="#06b6d4"/>
    <circle cx="1620" cy="360" r="200" fill="#a78bfa"/>
  </g>

  <!-- left-aligned text -->
  <g font-family="Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" fill="#ffffff">
    <text x="120" y="160" font-size="48" font-weight="600">Your Headline Here</text>
    <text x="120" y="220" font-size="28" fill-opacity="0.9">Subheadline or short description that supports the headline</text>
    <rect x="120" y="260" rx="6" ry="6" width="220" height="48" fill="#06b6d4"/>
    <text x="230" y="294" font-size="18" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" fill="#071133">Get Started</text>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle right-side image placeholder -->
  <g transform="translate(1340,60)">
    <rect width="440" height="360" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <text x="220" y="180" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.6">Image / Illustration</text>
  </g>
</svg>

Would you like:
- a different size (e.g., 1200×300 or social sizes)?
- different colors, text, or a logo placed in the banner?
- a generator prompt instead (I’ll craft one tuned for Midjourney/Stable Diffusion/Claude image models)?

Tell me which option and any style/text details and I’ll produce it.
